name: Hanatsubaki Michiru
source: [url=https://vndb.org/c88482]Hanatsubaki Hikaru's[/url] elder twin sister and a relative of [url=https://vndb.org/c1334]Hanatsubaki Gorou's[/url]. In addition to having her life as a student, Michiru is a fashion model. She's good at observing people, and never fails to collect information on them by her own efforts, either.
